pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar sitting at the foot of a tall tree, looking up towards a nest high above.
Fig the caterpillar climbing onto a long trailing strand of web hanging down a tree trunk.
The thin strand of web snapping, Fig the caterpillar tumbling down through the air.
Fig the caterpillar sitting on the ground again, looking up at a tree, disappointed.
Fig the caterpillar standing back up, determined, brushing himself off.
Fig the caterpillar climbing onto a sturdier strand of web higher up a tree trunk.
Fig the caterpillar climbing steadily and successfully up a strand towards a nest.
Fig the caterpillar settled happily at the top of the tree beside the nest, pleased with himself.
